title: gf2-core competitive performance
description:
Long-running tracker for performance work targeting Magma/Sage parity in `gf2-core` and pushing beyond on extension-field tower arithmetic. Currently scoped to one epic; future performance epics (gf2-coding LDPC throughput, GPU offload research) will hang under this milestone.

## Background

The project vision is research-grade finite-field computing competitive with specialized computer algebra systems (Magma/Sage). This milestone exists so that performance-oriented epics share a coherent home and can be tracked against the same benchmarking baseline. The scoped epic is `gf2-core-ppc-spiral` — a comprehensive PPC-spiral sweep through every scalar gap in `gf2-core` with proof-of-gain at every spiral step.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Every Tier A–D kernel from epic `gf2-core-ppc-spiral` ships its proof-of-gain artefact (criterion delta + asm + perf-stat).
- [hard] No `unsafe` outside `gf2-kernels-simd` / `gf2-kernels-hip` (apex constraint preserved).
- [hard] MSRV drift only happens with explicit user approval per `escalation-policy.md`.
- [aspirational] On a representative workload (LDPC-coded simulation, tower-field GEMM), `gf2-core` matches or beats Magma 2.28 on a single core.

## Notes

Future performance epics (gf2-coding LDPC throughput, GPU offload research, verification coverage) can hang under this milestone without restructuring.
